description: O1 plate clips (fusion/o1_clips.py): printed standing on their C profile, so a brim keeps them upright; solid and four walls so the jaws are stiff.
changelog: 2026-10-15  created from o1_jigs for side-printed C-clips
2026-10-15  process.brim_type: (preset default) -> outer_only  (clips stand 40-50 mm tall on a small C profile; a brim keeps them upright)
2026-10-15  process.sparse_infill_density: (preset default) -> 100%  (solid jaws: stiff clamp, no voids)
2026-10-15  process.sparse_infill_pattern: (preset default) -> zig-zag  (fills solid at 100% (gyroid does not))
2026-10-15  process.wall_loops: 3 -> 4  (jaws and hook mostly perimeters, the strongest way to bend them)
